subject: Spontaneous application – Data Engineering Internship | Natixis
body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am submitting my spontaneous application for a Data Engineering internship at Natixis in Paris. I am a Master’s Computer Science student (2024–2026) with a prior development internship where I built Python scripts and wrote SQL queries. I am keen to contribute to your data infrastructure initiatives in the banking sector.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application.

Best regards,
John Doe
Paris
john@example.com | +33 6 00 00 00 00

letter.name: John Doe
letter.subject: Spontaneous application – Data Engineering Internship
body: I am writing to express my interest in joining Natixis as a Data Engineering intern in Paris. Drawn by the challenges of data infrastructure in banking, I am motivated to contribute to projects that help teams leverage reliable data.

Currently pursuing a Master’s in Computer Science (2024–2026), I have developed a foundation in programming and databases. During a development internship at Entreprise Exemple in 2025, I built Python scripts and wrote SQL queries. I am also comfortable working with Linux and eager to deepen my skills in data engineering.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your teams and grow within Natixis. Thank you for considering my application.
